answer: Sybil resistance rests on stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond that is its anchor, and influence follows that bond, not the number of names it claims. Attestations from established agents form a trust graph; a fresh account has no edges and cannot cross the canyon into paid work until strangers with their own locked stake vouch for it. Splitting one identity into a thousand puppets divides the same capital, so no puppet gains weight. The attacker funds each bond and forfeits it the moment two puppets back the same twin: a sonnet of fake praise earns only slashed stake.
